invariants.description: charge conservation: the change of membrane charge Cm (V - V0) equals the change of ionic charge F [Vol (dNai + dKi) + 2 dN_Ca] plus the charge carried by the currents that change no tracked ion pool (I_in_delayed and I_out)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((Cm*1e-15*(V - V[0]) - F*(Vol*((Nai + Ki) - (Nai[0] + Ki[0])) + 2*((Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER)) - (Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[0]))) - (-1e-9*np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((I_out - I_in_delayed)[1:]+(I_out - I_in_delayed)[:-1])*np.diff(t))))))) <= 1e-3*(np.max(np.abs(Cm*1e-15*(V - V[0]))) + np.max(np.abs((-1e-9*np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((I_out - I_in_delayed)[1:]+(I_out - I_in_delayed)[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))))) + 1e-20

invariants.description: total Ca (free + buffered, all four compartments) changes only by the plasma-membrane fluxes: N_Ca(t) - N_Ca(0) = integral of (j_Ca_L + j_NaCa_Ca) dt (trapezoid on the output grid)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER)) - (Vol*(c_SL*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + (1 - c_SL - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((j_Ca_L + j_NaCa_Ca)[1:]+(j_Ca_L + j_NaCa_Ca)[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-3*np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((j_Ca_L + j_NaCa_Ca)[1:]+(j_Ca_L + j_NaCa_Ca)[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) + 1e-21
np.all((B_Cai >= -1e-9) & (B_Cai <= B_Ca_total + 1e-9)) & np.all((B_Ca_bulk >= -1e-9) & (B_Ca_bulk <= B_Ca_total + 1e-9)) & np.all((B_Ca_ER_pre >= -1e-9) & (B_Ca_ER_pre <= B_Ca_total + 1e-9))

invariants.description: Nernst: E_Na = 1000 RT/F ln(Nao/Nai), E_K = 1000 RT/F ln(Ko/Ki) (mV)

bc_sweep.rationale: injected current I_in from +0.2 nA (strong depolarising drive; the soma model uses I_in > 0 as outward) to +0.05 nA, axial current I_out +/-0.05 nA; zero-valued switches (Delta_V_mid_w, k_thresh_*, delta_gM, rho_IP3R (IP3R density; k_IP3 = A_ER rho_IP3R k_IP3R_single)) over their plausible ranges; all other constants by factors 0.5-2 of their values, except that the free-buffer initial value must not exceed B_Ca_total (B_Ca_init 4-7.95 mM, B_Ca_total 8-16 mM) and h_IP3_init spans [0, 1]. The diameter d spans the cube roots of the factors, so the volume k_V d^3 spans 0.5-2 (as Vol did); k_A, c_m, the densities and the per-protein rates scale their products by 0.5-2 (as Cm and the conductances did).
